rows: Updates to JAX flash attention kernel.
End2End Video SFT with Varied Size/Duration
Add launch scripts and configurations for Distillation Training.
Add standalone checkpointer benchmark features and Orbax configuratio…
Support extracting router replay expert indices from MaxText inference
Support inserting and replaying router expert decisions in trainer
allow grain to read tfds config
Fix fp8 MoE on the sparse_matmul path
Update load balance loss, bias term updates, and mlperf input pipeline
Add explicit sharding support for the Qwen3 model family
Onboard explicit sharding to the Gemma models
Split 'embed' logical name for attention weights into 'embed_attn'
fix(eval mesh): shard attention with the logical axis rules active at eval
Skip MLA flash attention with all-gather CP on TPU7x
Add fsdp-as-dp-for-attn custom mesh and rule
fix(rl): Patch MoE weight tracking and adjust vLLM HBM utilization
Improve testing for Muon and the sharded Muon variant.
Support partitioned optimizer state sharding propagation and MaskedNode filtering in Zero-1.
Scale Qwen3 test query and KV head counts to 8
Add ChartNet SFT configuration and support
Use native block-sparse attention for indexer mask under CP
Onboard Mistral and Mixtral to explicit sharding and efficient ZeRO-1 + GA
Fix dropped routing-weight gradient in ring_ragged_unsort
Replace deprecated google-cloud-sdk package with google-cloud-cli in Dockerfiles
[CI Fix] Disable pylint unbalanced-tuple-unpacking in nnx_decoders_test
Remove duplicate mesh axis parallelism maps from create_device_mesh
Format and lint across MoE and decoder files.
Fix KL divergence regression for Qwen3 in AUTO shard mode
Fix RLConfig mesh initialization to prevent NoneType AttributeError
Migrate scripts and docs from tfds pipeline to grain
[Maxtext][vLLM] Normalize MRoPE position shapes for vLLM
